sources.entry: Parallels - Powerful, easy-to-use VM. No free upgrade for each new Mac OS.

summary.name: Parallels Desktop
summary.one_liner: Parallels Desktop is a commercial virtualization app for macOS that runs Windows on Intel and Apple silicon Macs, with Parallels RAS offered for enterprise virtual apps and VDI.
use_cases: Running Windows-only applications on a Mac
Switching between macOS and Windows on one machine
Replicating user problems on different operating systems for support
Delivering virtual apps and VDI to employees
Building secure digital workspaces for enterprises
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Parallels Desktop for Mac as a way to run Windows on Intel and Apple silicon Macs with integration between the two operating systems. It states the product is used by over 7 million Mac users and cites a 2024 Top Rated award. Parallels RAS is mentioned as a separate enterprise solution for virtual apps, VDI and secure digital workspaces. The page includes user testimonials and a partner recruitment section, with no detailed feature list, pricing, or system requirements.
notable: Runs Windows on both Intel and Apple silicon Macs
Parallels RAS for enterprise virtual apps and VDI
caveats: The page does not state pricing or whether a free tier exists
The listing notes there is no free upgrade for each new macOS version
